notes.title: Release 0.11.0: Customizable games
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Another big feature is here.
Ever wanted to play the game without them damn hell dogs spawning in and ruining your game? Now you can.
Has your game ever been ruined by the world boss? Now you can remove him.
Have you ever wanted to play the game with the normal zombies that can only be killed by headshots? This is the day it's possible now.

Now you can control different aspects of what's in the game at the cost of earning little to no XP:
-Is building allowed
-Which zombie types are allowed
-Are bosses allowed
-Money earned
-Zombie damage
-etc.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623971/e9374e4ef080005ad52f9875bc2ee8fc60f525ec.png[/img]

Release notes 0.11.0

-Add in suppressors for some of the guns in the game. Reduces the noise of the shots, reduces zombie aggression towards that player, increases recoil
-Improve aim assist for controllers with the option to control their strength. The cursor will move toward the closest zombie to where the player is aiming and will dynamically adjust the aiming sensitivity, the closer to the zombie the smaller the sensitivity.
-Allow CTRL, SHIFT, and ALT to be reminded to other keys
-Allow MOUSE WHEEL to be rebound to other keys
-Add option to control the AIMING SENSITIVITY for both MOUSE and CONTROLLER
-Add an option for hosts to control the way the game plays
-Fixed clients sometimes paying for LASER FENCE but nothing appears(it might still not appear but won't cost anything)
-Don't render the building boundaries for LASER FENCES and when other players are placing the buildings
-Implement VANGUARD MINIGUN damage upgrade

notes.title: Release 0.10.0: New Map and Game Customization Features

Hey everyone,
It's update time, and we’re excited to bring you some major additions in this release.

notes.title: Release Notes 0.9.0: New skill tree
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce the release of the 3rd skill tree! Dive into new strategies and unleash unique abilities as you explore this fresh addition to your arsenal. Please note: only the skills from your currently selected skill tree will now be active, emphasizing focused and strategic gameplay. Choose your class wisely and adapt to the challenges ahead!

Upcoming Features Sneak Peek:
Here’s a glimpse at what’s coming soon in future updates:

Team Weapon Upgrades: Work together to upgrade your team’s arsenal, bringing even more depth to cooperative gameplay.
Weapon Upgrade Money Sink: Players will soon be able to sink resources into upgrading weapon damage over time, offering a steady progression path and a meaningful use for excess funds.

WORKBENCH

-Add weapon upgrade in the normal world after defeating the boss
-Fixed zombies simply walking through certain buildings and not melee attacking them
-Increase tesla tower limit to 4 and 6 with architect perk

notes.title: Update 0.6.14
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.14:
-Combine the second and third areas on the Airport map
-Damage the player, if they are fixing a barrier and a zombie, is attacking it
-Fixed player being able to get out of the map on the Airport Map(hopefully)
-Fixed player's weapons doing damage to the spiked fence
-Fixed zombies running through defences
-Increase hip fire accuracy by 100%
-Increase the wave everyone is running to wave 20
-Limit the amount of freezing sound effects played when freezing multiple zombies
-Make the first tier 1 weapon upgrade for free in hell after defeating the boss

notes.title: Update 0.6.13
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.13:
-Fixed barbed wire showing the slowdown upgrades like it is making them worse
-Fixed the invisible zombies, for real now
-Fixed the repair all price showing up different compared to when using it for the client
-Give zombies fixed reward amount
-Increase Mechanic monster damage to the defend the objective by quite a bit
-Increase SENTINEL GL32 damage by 250%
-Increase armor price by 400%
-Increase mechanic monster default speed by 240%
-Increase the slowdown effect from the goo zombie by 100%
-Increase witches slowdown effect on player by 30%

-Potentially fix the zombies getting stuck in the stairwell on Airport Terminal map
-Potentially fixed the zombies standing on or in the well on the Cemetery map
-Reduce SILENTSTALKER recoil by 50%
-Reduce the grabbers pull speed by 50%
-Reduce the suicider explosion range by 50%
-Reduce witch screen shake by 30%
-Show the value of each of the skills in it's description
-Slow down the player when there are too many zombies around them

notes.title: Update 0.6.12
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.12:
-Fixed the invisible zombies
-For skill TIME FOR SOME REVENGE, do not respawn with perks
-Limit the maximum multiplier for the PRECISION PAYDAY perk to 4x
-Potentially fixed the zombies getting stuck in the airport map stairwell

notes.title: Update 0.6.11
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.11:
-Actually, increase the cost of SILENTSTALKER from 0.6.9
-Changed the skill that reduces mystery box cost to 10%, makes a nice round number now
-Fixed mystery box opening audio continuously looping
-Fixed one of the engineering skills showing 0/1 and 1/1 at the same time, also, added a new skill
-Fixed when getting grabbed the weapon continues to fire
-Fixed zombies not getting killed by the electric fence when jumping through windows
-Potentially fix the grenade bug where the player gets stuck in it

notes.title: Update 0.6.10
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.10:
-Decrease build phase time by 30 seconds
-Fix issues when accepting a game invite without the game open
-Fixed duplicate players in the lobby
-Increase mystery box cost by $500
-Potentially fix rare cases where the save files become corrupt

notes.title: Update 0.6.9
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.9:
-Fixed a bug where zombies were missing the disappear, electric, or on-fire visual effects
-Fixed an issue where buildings did not synchronize properly for new players joining in progress
-Increased headshot damage by 25% for a more rewarding shooting experience
-Potential fix implemented for an issue where zombies appeared alive on the client side but were dead on the host
-Reduced weapon recoil by 20% for improved shooting accuracy
-Updated weapon stats for better balancing

notes.title: Update 0.6.8
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.8:
-Change the spawning dog's behaviour, as the wave progresses, spawn multiple of them at the same time
-Changed auto sentry build limit to 4
-Changed tesla tower build limit to 3
-Decrease mechanic monster teleport rate
-Decrease the minigun damage by 20%
-Decrease the minigun magazine size by 40%
-Disable the zombie respawning mechanism when the players are too far away
-Fixed explosive barrels sometimes destroy your buildings
-Fixed issues with the Phoenix perk on offline mode to defend the objective game mode
-Fixed mechanic monster bugging out and becoming invulnerable when all players are dead
-Fixed mouse buttons not being bindable
-Fixed pressing the "E" key in the chat while on the mounted gun kicking the player off
-Fixed sentry damage upgrade showing as if it loses damage when upgrading, the same fix might apply to other upgrades
-Increase zombie health for all difficulties(some more than others)
-Increased laser fence health by 150%
-Increased total zombie count per wave on all difficulties by around 20%
-Normal zombies will target teleporter
-Potentially fix the menus scrolling up constantly
-Reduce boss health
-Reduce mechanical monster health when more than 1 player is in the game
-Reduce the hell dog's stun strength by 50%

notes.title: Update 0.6.7
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.7:
-Reduce sentry damage by 15%
-Reduced mounted heavy machine gun damage by 40% and set build limit to 2
-Updated german, dutch, korean and russian localisations
-Fixed fortress and the building repair skill costing money when used as a client
-Fixed lurker boss stopping after picking up the host player
-Fixed explosive buildings damaging and destroying other buildings

notes.title: Update 0.6.6
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.6:
-Fixed a spelling mistake with "PURCHASE NEW WEAPON"
-Fixed controller pointing downwards when aiming
-Fixed free buildings not possible to repair(ammo box)

notes.title: Update 0.6.5
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.5:
-Fixed the options menu going crazy with the mouse wheel
-Fixed the price of some buildings(mainly ammo box) being a negative value
-Fixed the repair all button having a negative repair value, therefore doing nothing when pressed
-Fixed the server not syncing the game mode properly with the client, most notably some clients would fall to their death when teleporting to hell
-Fixed the voting yes/no text to fit properly

notes.title: Update 0.6.4
notes.notes:
Release notes 0.6.4:
-Added difficulty on the server browser
-Changed the chance to repair all buildings from 50% to 10%
-Fixed money popups sometimes not showing up in the bottom left of the screen
-Fixed placement issues, especially on the cemetery map
-Update russian localisation

notes.title: Update 0.6.3
notes.notes:
Release 0.6.3:
-Changed quick matching button, now servers that are nearly full and close to the start of the game will be preferred over games that are really far in. Wave 20 and above will be ignored.
-Fixed the multiplayer issues, most of the joining issues and gameplay issues(introduced in 0.6.2)
-Fixed the player getting stuck in the grenade throwing animation
-Fixed SENTINEL GL32 and RPG not rearming at ammo boxes
-Updated the engine version, should reduce the amount of crashes

notes.title: Update 0.6.2
notes.notes:
Release notes for 0.6.2:
-Fixed controller vertical axis being too sensitive
-Fixed clients not going on the leaderboard, only host going there
-Fixed the lurker boss
-Fixed mounted gun not being mountable if that player left the game while still on it
-Fixed join in progress players not getting current discounts in the shop

notes.title: Update 0.6.1

-Add mounted gun looking sensitivity sliders
-Doubled the amount of hell hounds that will be alive after wave 5
-Fixed other players characters sometimes floating
-Fixed duplicated players bottom left
-Fixed the wrong amount of xp/levels shown when you finish a game, correct xp was awared before, just didn't show properly
-Fixed the jaggy zombie path on defend the objective

-Fixed the laser fence having infinite health
-Potentially fix zombies getting stuck at the airport by the staircase

notes.title: Update to the demo build
notes.notes:
Hi all. We are still working very hard to get a proper release date out. Until then, here's a update that includes several changes.

- Reworked recoil on the guns
- Added leader boards
- Added ammo icon to the ammo boxes
- Fixed zombies sometimes freezing mid air
- Fixed plasma gun doing no damage on single shots
- Added localised texts to the game
- Added a menu in the lobby that shows different stats that get changed for each of the difficulty, this will be used a way to customise the game experience for custom lobbies on the full game
- Fixed non English characters not being rendered correctly for players names
- Field of view slider
- Few other fixes and changes that are slipping my mind right now

Thanks everyone.
